name: 轻躁狂检测清单
instructions: 请回忆您处于“情绪高涨”或精力特别充沛的一段时期，您当时是否比平时更频繁地出现以下体验？请据实回答。
instructionsEn: Please recall a period when you felt “high” or especially full of energy. Did you experience the following more often than usual during that time? Please answer honestly.
license: Angst 等编制，可免费使用，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 我需要的睡眠更少
items.textEn: I need less sleep than other people (for example, I only need 3 hours of sleep)

items.text: 我感到精力更加充沛、活动更多
items.textEn: I feel more energetic and more active

items.text: 我更加自信
items.textEn: I am more self-confident than usual

items.text: 我更加喜欢我的工作
items.textEn: I enjoy my work much more than usual

items.text: 我更加爱交际（打电话更多、外出更多）
items.textEn: I am more sociable (I make more phone calls and go out more)

items.text: 我想去旅行，或真的去旅行更多
items.textEn: I want to travel, or actually travel more

items.text: 我开车更快，或开车时更爱冒险
items.textEn: I drive faster/more riskily than usual

items.text: 我花钱更多、太多
items.textEn: I spend money more freely than usual

items.text: 我在日常生活中（工作或其他活动中）更爱冒险
items.textEn: I take more risks in my daily life (at work or in other activities)

items.text: 我体力上更活跃（运动等）
items.textEn: I am physically more active (sport, shopping, sex)

items.text: 我计划了更多活动或项目
items.textEn: I plan more activities or projects

items.text: 我有更多想法、更有创造力
items.textEn: I have more ideas and am more creative than usual

items.text: 我不那么害羞或拘谨
items.textEn: I am less shy or reserved

items.text: 我穿更鲜艳、更夸张的衣服或化妆
items.textEn: I wear brighter or more extravagant clothes or makeup

items.text: 我想见或真的去见更多的人
items.textEn: I want to see, or actually see, more people

items.text: 我对性更感兴趣，或性欲增强
items.textEn: I am more interested in sex than usual, or my libido increases

items.text: 我更爱调情，或性生活更频繁
items.textEn: I flirt more, or have sex more often

items.text: 我说话更多
items.textEn: I talk more than usual

items.text: 我思维更快
items.textEn: I feel that my thoughts come faster

items.text: 我说话时开更多玩笑或双关语
items.textEn: I make more jokes or puns when I talk

items.text: 我更容易分心
items.textEn: I am more easily distracted and it is hard to stay focused on one thing

items.text: 我从事很多新的事情
items.textEn: I take on many new things

items.text: 我的思绪从一个话题跳到另一个话题
items.textEn: My thoughts jump from one topic to another

items.text: 我做事更快、更容易
items.textEn: I do things faster and more easily

items.text: 我更没耐心，或更容易烦躁
items.textEn: I have less patience, or become irritated more easily

items.text: 我可能让别人精疲力尽或感到厌烦
items.textEn: I may exhaust or bore other people

items.text: 我更多与人争吵
items.textEn: I am more prone to getting into arguments

items.text: 我的情绪更高涨、更乐观
items.textEn: I am naturally more cheerful and optimistic than most people

items.text: 我喝更多咖啡
items.textEn: I drink more coffee

items.text: 我抽更多烟
items.textEn: I smoke more

items.text: 我喝更多酒
items.textEn: I drink more alcohol

items.text: 我服用更多药物（镇静剂、抗焦虑药、兴奋剂等）
items.textEn: I take more medications (sedatives, anti-anxiety drugs, stimulants, etc.)

totalBands.description: 阳性条目数少于14条，未提示轻躁狂倾向。
阳性条目数达到14条及以上，提示可能存在轻躁狂倾向，建议进一步专业评估。
